verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no in-product rule or automation builder where a user defines event-triggered actions. Workable offers webhook subscriptions that notify an external service when candidate events fire. That is a developer building block a user would need to wire up to their own action logic, so it earns no credit toward this story. The MCP server is assistant-mediated, on-demand operation, not rules that trigger actions on events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You can subscribe to an event and Workable will notify you when it's triggered.
The args object can be used to further filter which candidate events you want to receive.
